data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a favourable development of GBP 3.5m (2017: favourable development of GBP 14.6m); this comprises releases of GBP 1.9m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business and releases of GBP 1.5m in respect of total Reinsurance business. In addition to the favourable development reported above, the Syndicate result has also benefited from the resolution of a dispute between Newline Corporate Name Limited and a third party administrator, in respect of a number of historic binding authority agreements with the Syndicate. This has resulted in the return of certain claims paid under these binding authority agreements and legal costs totalling GBP 11.75m.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports a net favourable prior-year development (net of reinsurance) of GBP 3.5m, while analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows an overall gross release of approximately GBP 22.7m (c.4.6% of opening gross reserves). Releases were concentrated in Third Party Liability (Casualty) and Reinsurance acceptances, and the result was materially helped by the settlement of a historic binding-authority dispute which returned certain claims and legal costs (reported at GBP 11.75m). The syndicate notes prior-year releases across Casualty classes and favourable development in both direct liability and reinsurance portfolios.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (gross) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 36). The Movement note on page 22 reports a NET favourable development of GBP 3.5m; the difference versus the gross triangle-derived release (~GBP 22.7m) is due to reinsurance recoveries and the separate benefit from the binding-authority dispute resolution (return of claims and legal costs GBP 11.75m). The triangle includes an aggregated '2010 & prior' column which was excluded from the diagonal calculation per rules. No RITC distortion was identified.
